# stb_image / stb_image_write

Pinned single-header PNG decoder (stb_image v2.32) and encoder (stb_image_write v1.18), public domain or MIT (terms at the end of each
header). Revision and hashes: UPSTREAM.json. Compiled only in `runtime/ddraw/texture_pack.cpp` with `STBI_ONLY_PNG`, for the opt-in texture
pack (decode) and texture dump (encode). The files are unmodified.
